notes.title: "Silent But Deadly Night" Holiday update!
notes.notes:
The "[b]Silent But Deadly Night[/b]" Holiday update introduces "[b]Evil Santa[/b]" and "[b]Frotsy The Snowman[/b]". These two bring with them a more challenging method of play with the potential for even greater rewards!

It also features 4 new Winter-themed levels, 2 more Achievements, minor gameplay tweaks and bug fixes.

Download this free update now! Happy Holidays!
